item.title: Jan. 6 rioter pardoned by Trump gets life sentence for molesting 2 children in Florida
item.description: A Florida handyman who was sentenced on Thursday to life in prison for molesting two children had been convicted of storming the Capitol on Jan. 6, 2021, but was pardoned by President Donald Trump.

item.title: New York tax returns feature new child credits and inflation refund requirements
item.description: New Yorkers filing their 2025 taxes should be aware of the new requirements and updated credits, such as the Empire State Child Credit and the inflation refund checks, while the IRS may be difficult to reach due to reduced staff and call center hours.
